title: Customer Director
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Retail and Consumer team is dedicated to helping clients deliver their strategic objectives through the successful application of Data Science and Frontier AI.

Our work spans the full spectrum of AI capabilities from machine learning to computer vision, simulation, optimisation, generative AI, agentic systems, and bringing these capabilities together in decision intelligence applications. Our solutions help clients understand and better engage with customers, improve commercial and trading decisions, improve the efficiency of end to end operations, and improve colleague experience.

About the role

As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts and shape our go-to-market strategy in order to achieve our ambitious growth targets.

You will act as a strategic partner to our Retail clients, helping them reinvent the way they engage with customers, and the way they operate across commercial, supply chain, stores, online and support functions with AI. You will build enduring relationships with senior stakeholders, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact.

This is an opportunity to help build a distinctive practice inside a company with world-class technical depth and the ambition to set the standard for AI in the Retail sector.

The ideal candidate will be T-shaped: broad enough to advise across AI for a range of firms including adjacent consumer facing sectors, with deep experience in Grocery and/or Fashion & Apparel sectors. We are particularly interested in candidates who have delivered enterprise AI solutions that have enabled real world impact.


What you'll be doing:

  • Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and identifying new clients within the Retail sector (specifically Grocery and Fashion & Apparel)

  • Leading complex AI transformation programmes for major Retail clients, moving from strategic thinking to production-grade software delivery

  • Building trusted, long-term relationships with C-suite leaders and partners, acting as a strategic advisor on how AI can automate knowledge work and drive operational efficiency

  • Generating high-value growth for Faculty by shaping compelling commercial pitches and demos that showcase our technical depth and ability to solve sector-specific challenges

  • Elevating Faculty’s industry profile by articulating differentiated propositions and points of view through thought leadership, media engagement, and industry forums

  • Ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality client work by guiding multidisciplinary teams and helping them navigate the ambiguity and pace of the sector

  • Managing a practice within a practice - leading cross-functional teams of delivery experts, PhD-calibre engineers and data scientists to further consolidate Faculty’s reputation for pioneering technical and delivery excellence.

Who we're looking for:

  • You’ve managed C-level, complex stakeholder relationships in the Retail industry, with a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships and navigating strategic commercial conversations with confidence

  • You’re commercially driven - energised by hitting growth targets with a proven track record of shaping opportunities, winning work, and owning meaningful revenue responsibility

  • You are delivery-focused and technically credible, with a track record of translating complex AI concepts with clarity to technical and non-technical audiences

  • You are comfortable working alongside deeply technical teams and possess the curiosity to master and discuss AI applications.

  • You exhibit a leadership mindset that balances executive-level strategy with a hands-on approach to unblocking teams, challenging work constructively, and maintaining high quality

  • Some experience in consulting preferred

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Commercial Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

About the Role

OpenAI’s top-of-funnel is evolving into a signal-driven, data-orchestrated engine powered by AI-native workflows, enriched customer intelligence, and increasingly interconnected systems. We are looking for a Technical Systems Program Manager to help drive the strategy, alignment, prioritization, and execution of these systems across Salesforce and adjacent platforms.

This role will partner closely with Engineering, Revenue Operations, Data, and Enterprise Platform teams to operationalize scalable CRM workflows. The ideal candidate combines strong technical fluency, operational systems thinking, and stakeholder leadership with the ability to drive execution across highly cross-functional environments.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and the team works a hybrid schedule (Monday - Wednesday in office). We will offer relocation assistance if needed. 

In this role, you will:

Own and drive CRM systems initiatives across support

Partner with senior business stakeholders and engineering teams to identify operational pain points, define scalable solutions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and execute across Salesforce and adjacent platforms

Align cross-functional stakeholders including Revenue Operations, Support Delivery, Risk, Engineering, Data, Legal, and Enterprise Platform teams while driving prioritization and execution 

Help operationalize AI-native workflows by defining and building scalable automation, orchestration, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes in partnership with cross-functional teams

You have 8+ years of experience driving high-impact technical programs in a program management, technical program management or adjacent role

Strong understanding of CRM workflows customer systems supporting user operations or support organizations

Proven ability to drive complex cross-functional initiatives from discovery and stakeholder alignment through execution and operationalization

title: Senior Accessibility Program Manager
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it. 

 

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally. 

 

 The successful candidate will:

  • Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
  • Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
  • Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
  • Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
  • Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology. 

Responsibilities

 The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to: 

  • Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.

  • Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.

  • Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.

  • Help improve the accessibility of open source by empowering people with disabilities to contribute, improving the availability and adoption of open-source Assistive Technologies, and improving the accessibility of mainstream open-source projects. 

The Senior Accessibility Program Manager may contribute to all of those program goals over time. That said, their initial focus will include, but is not limited to:

  • Manage listening systems including inclusive user research and feedback processes.
  • Build an accessibility community of practice within our Enterprise customer community.
  • Grow the capabilities of the open-source GitHub accessibility scanner and accelerate adoption by customers and open-source communities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications :

  • 7+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Master's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 3+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR Doctorate in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 1+ year(s) experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience driving programs or initiatives across organizational boundaries in a large organization.
  • 3+ years of experience evaluating the conformance of web content against the Web Content Accessibility guidelines.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing accessible web-based user interfaces using JavaScript and modern web technologies.
  • Experience collecting and interpreting data for performance metrics and compliance.
  • Understanding of product road mapping and experience working with product and engineering teams to embed new features into roadmap plans. 

We encourage people with lived experience to apply. 


Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $103,200.00 - USD $273,700.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. About GitHub

  • Do you love the challenge of diving into the details and learning why and how things work?

This is an excellent opportunity for an independent contributor to have a hand in elevating risk management and security as business and sales enabler as well as integrate a deeper understanding of risk management into the product and business space. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead security capability risk assessments for assigned areas, including scoping against NIST CSF subcategories, coordinating schedules and stakeholder interviews, completing maturity scoring, and publishing assessment reports. 

  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify, analyze, and prioritize technical risks, develop and quantify FAIR-style cyber risk scenarios, evaluate capabilities against established frameworks, and assess potential impacts to GitHub – our products, services, customers, and business objectives. 

  • Partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders to validate findings, identify risk patterns, and translate technical insights and stakeholder feedback into practical risk recommendations. 

  • Develop and manage risk treatment plans, drive adoption of appropriate mitigations and remediation, monitor treatment progress, and escalate unresolved or emerging risks. 

  • Maintain the risk register and supporting records in GitHub’s GRC system of record, track mitigation progress, and provide clear, recurring risk updates to technical and non-technical leaders. 

 


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 7+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area;

    • o OR Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area
    • o OR Master's Degree AND 3+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area
    • o OR Doctorate AND 1+ year(s) experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area
    • o OR equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years experience applying security or control frameworks, such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, or ISO/IEC 27001. 

  • 5+ years experience in technical risk management, information security, audit, or compliance. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience applying cyber risk quantification (CRQ) using FAIR or a comparable quantitative risk analysis method, including developing risk scenarios and estimating loss event frequency and loss magnitude to produce defensible loss exposure ranges that express risk in financial terms and support risk-informed investment and risk-acceptance decisions.  

  • Experience with GRC platforms used to maintain risk registers and risk treatment plans (ZenGRC, ServiceNow GRC, Archer, or comparable).

Description

Amazon Robotics is seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead hardware program delivery for the Sortation Vertical. You will own the full program lifecycle for next-generation sortation hardware — from concept through engineering validation, multi-site deployment, and sustaining support in the field.

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the

idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit

right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply

advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers'

experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet.

This role sits on the Sortation Hardware Engineering team and is the single-threaded program owner for our hardware portfolio. You will drive the mechanical and electromechanical programs that deploy into Amazon's Sortation Centers at scale, working across Systems Engineering, Deployment Engineering, Solutions, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, Product, and Customer Support. You will own the program schedule, the change-control cadence, the supplier and procurement path, and the launch readiness gate — and you will be accountable when those slip.

You will be successful in this role if you are equally comfortable running a design review, chasing

a long-lead component through a contract manufacturer, and standing on a sort center floor at 6am during an install.

Key job responsibilities

• You will own end-to-end delivery of sortation hardware programs across all engineering disciplines, holding the schedule and the critical path across teams that do not report to you and driving technical decisions to closure on the record. 

• You will own the change-control cadence for the hardware portfolio, ensuring our contract manufacturers and deployment partners build to the released revision.

• You will own the procurement path for program hardware, translating supplier lead times on long-lead components into schedule risk before they become launch impacts. 

• You will own launch readiness for site deployments through the go/no-go decision and the handover to site Reliability Maintenance Engineering and Operations, and you will sustain solutions already in the field.

A day in the life

One morning you are deciding whether a bracket that does not fit stops a live install. That afternoon you are working out whether a cable assembly running three weeks late moves a launch date, and pushing a stalled engineering change through to release. Some weeks you are at your desk owning the schedule and the readiness summary leadership will read before a site goes live. Some weeks you are on a sort center floor with a tape measure. Both are the job.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical program management experience

- Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field

- 5+ years of experience working directly with hardware engineering teams

- Experience taking electromechanical hardware from prototype through production and field deployment

Preferred Qualifications

- 7+ years of technical program management experience

- Experience designing or implementing integrated automation solutions such as material handling systems, high-speed packaging lines, or manufacturing lines

- 4+ years of change management experience

- Experience managing contract manufacturers and long-lead component supply chains, including translating lead-time risk into schedule impact

- Experience managing NPI validation gates (EVT/DVT/PVT) and multi-site deployment launches

- Experience with capital planning and procurement mechanics — purchase requisitions, capital requests, and vendor qualification

- Experience owning technology handover to a maintenance or operations organization

- Master's degree, MBA, or PMP certification

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.


We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the SMB Marketing team helps small and medium-sized businesses understand and adopt ChatGPT Business and OpenAI’s B2B solutions. We build a deep understanding of business owners and teams, shape relevant product narratives, and drive awareness, adoption, and growth.

We take a data-driven approach to understand SMB audiences, uncover customer needs, and translate AI capabilities into practical business value. We partner closely with Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, Research, Communications, and Design to deliver a cohesive customer experience across discovery, evaluation, purchase, adoption, and expansion.

About the Role

We are hiring a Portfolio Product Marketing Lead to define and scale OpenAI’s global audience marketing strategy for small and medium-sized businesses. This leader will own how business owners, decision-makers, and teams understand, evaluate, adopt, and grow with ChatGPT Business and OpenAI’s SMB B2B solutions.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role where you will shape clear, compelling narratives that show how AI helps SMBs solve everyday business challenges. You will build the content, customer stories, thought leadership, events, and integrated programs that drive ChatGPT Business subscriptions, team adoption, seat expansion, and long-term growth.

You will partner closely with Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, Communications, Research, and Data Science to make OpenAI a trusted partner for SMBs adopting AI and turning it into measurable business value.

This role is ideally based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid schedule of three days per week in the office.

In This Role, You Will:

Own SMB audience strategy and positioning for ChatGPT Business and SMB B2B solutions, translating customer needs into differentiated messaging and clear reasons to adopt.

Lead thought leadership and content strategy, using practical education, demos, and customer stories to show how SMBs can put AI to work and achieve measurable results.

Develop go-to-market programs for priority SMB industries, equipping Sales, Partnerships, and Growth teams with tailored narratives, proof points, and enablement.

Partner with Growth and channel teams on integrated campaigns, lifecycle marketing, communities, and events that drive self-serve conversion, sales-assisted opportunities, retention, and expansion.

Partner with Product Marketing and Product teams to turn roadmap innovations into audience-relevant launches, customer education, and adoption programs.

Build and lead a high-performing team, establishing measurement frameworks to assess engagement, conversion, adoption, and revenue impact.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

Have 12+ years of experience in B2B marketing or go-to-market leadership, including building programs that drive SMB adoption and growth at a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

Understand how SMB owners and teams evaluate, buy, and adopt software—from resource constraints and proof of value to self-serve and sales-assisted buying journeys—and how AI can improve their everyday workflows.

Can translate complex technology into clear positioning, audience narratives, and thought leadership that resonate across SMB segments.

Have built content and enablement programs spanning customer education, practical use cases, customer stories, webinars, workshops, and community engagement.

Are highly analytical, with experience connecting marketing investments to conversion, adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue outcomes.

Are a strong people leader who can attract top talent, set a high quality bar, and build new functions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

title: Senior Manager, Financial Partnerships, Banking & New Market Development, EMEA
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Own Airwallex’s banking partnerships strategy across the UK and Europe, supporting the growth of our global collections and payouts network.

  • Build and manage strategic relationships with banking partners, financial institutions, payment networks, local acquirers and payment methods, acting as the main point of contact between Airwallex and our partners.

  • Identify and evaluate partnership opportunities as Airwallex expands into new geographies, using market research and competitive insight to strengthen our position as a payments leader.

  • Coordinate due diligence and project-manage onboarding with prospective partners, working across Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Commercial teams to move complex opportunities forward.

  • Develop your profile as an industry thought leader while working with banking infrastructure that supports Airwallex’s growth across the UK and Europe.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 10+ years’ experience working with financial institutions, global and regional banks, and payment networks.

  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with financial institutions in the UK and Europe while working at a payment institution or EMI.

  • A strong network of banking partners, financial institutions and payment networks.

  • Strong understanding of compliance and onboarding requirements for global and regional banks.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Commercial.

  • International experience working across multiple markets or managing cross-border relationships.

  • A proven track record of working with technology-led businesses in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to connect with people at all levels and communicate project expectations clearly.

  • Strong negotiation skills, with the judgment to navigate complex commercial discussions and secure the best outcomes for Airwallex.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build and maintain trusted relationships.

  • A self-starter who thinks creatively and works effectively through ambiguity and constant change.

  • A collaborative team player who can work cohesively across the organisation and inspire a shared vision.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You stay close to your industry, follow trends, and bring outside perspective into your work.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

  • You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team's direction once a call is made.

Learn more about your team

Financial & Strategic Partnerships builds the relationships that expand what our platform can do and where it can go next. This team structures deals with financial institutions, fintech platforms, and enterprise software companies that embed Airwallex's infrastructure into their own products: commercially complex work that accelerates growth, opens new markets, and extends distribution reach.

It's a function for strategic thinkers and dealmakers who think in systems, with range across commercial negotiation, technical scoping, and cross-functional coordination. The work is open-ended by nature, and the best outcomes come from people who thrive without an inherited playbook.

If you want to identify, define, and negotiate consequential commercial relationships at the frontier of global finance, this team does the kind of work that will challenge and motivate you.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Energy Analytics, TPM, Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation

Job ID: 10586385 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.

You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.

Key job responsibilities

● Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results.  Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.

● Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets.  Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.

● Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies.  Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.

● Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).

● Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.

● Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.

● Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.

● Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.

● Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)

● Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit

● Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.

● Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.

● Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.

● Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.

A day in the life

You might spend the morning querying newly integrated power-metering data and validating it against the distribution-panel hierarchy — resolving a data-quality gap — then analyzing load profiles and build an energy-savings or peak-shaving model that quantifies the opportunity by equipment class. You then define network rollout suitability and prioritize these opportunities across sites. In the afternoon you develop control logic changes to implement an efficiency opportunity, propose updates to a design standard, or define a measurement method for implemented energy and cost savings to your stakeholders. You balance trade-offs between energy savings, technical complexity, equipment reliability, and cost — bringing well-reasoned recommendations and escalating the most ambiguous decisions for alignment.

About the team

The Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation (GESA) Energy team is dedicated to delivering energy efficiency, cost savings, and demand flexibility within Amazon's fulfillment network. We partner closely with design, controls, data, procurement, operations, field engineering, and deployment teams — as well as external vendors — to ensure our energy consumption is monitored and optimized. Our focus in the coming years is scaling our energy monitoring and analytics programs, expanding behavioral and retrofit programs, expanding load flexibility for power resilience and cost arbitrage benefit, and enhancing asset reliability and lifespan through efficient operation. If you are energized by large-scale technical challenges and want to make a tangible impact on energy use, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

- Experience in SQL Server/MySQL, or experience in Redshift and experience in any Bigdata architecture

- Experience working with existing and emerging technologies related to building energy (i.e. power metering, conveyance, robotics, controls, HVAC, charging infrastructure)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing cross-functional programs and release schedules

- Familiarity with automation engineering and controls engineering concepts.

- Industry certifications: Certified Energy Manager, Certified Measurement & Verification Professional, Professional Engineer.

Description

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead regulatory, functional safety, compliance, and road-readiness programs for Amazon’s autonomous delivery vehicle initiative. The Senior TPM will also manage complex dependencies with external autonomy providers, vehicle manufacturers, suppliers, and other technology partners, ensuring that safety requirements, regulatory obligations, technical evidence, and operational controls remain aligned across organizational boundaries. The role involves partnering with manufacturing suppliers (OSATs or CMs) and collaborating with internal cross-functional teams, including NPI Operations, Procurement, and Engineering, to optimize product design and process for manufacturability.

The successful candidate will develop and implement robust factory and quality control systems to ensure high standards for incoming and outgoing product quality. They will deliver efficient, scalable manufacturing solutions that achieve high yields, low costs, and the ability to meet critical timelines.

This role also serves as a key point of contact during factory or quality excursions, providing clear and timely communication to management, cross-functional teams, and suppliers. The candidate will proactively identify, address, and prevent critical issues while driving continuous improvement in factory operations and product quality.

Minimum Qualifications

Strong understanding of product quality and reliability, with a knowledge of industry standards and best practices.

Data-driven decision-making, with proficiency in tools such as JMP and Tableau for analysis and visualization.
Experience collaborating with Asia-based manufacturing suppliers to ensure quality and maintain strong partnerships.
Proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams, promoting collaboration among diverse individuals with varying levels of expertise.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts, create comprehensive documentation, and deliver impactful presentations.
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and deliver results in fast-paced environments.

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $163,500 and $246,200, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

title: Senior Portfolio Operations Manager, Games
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix Games is looking for a Senior Portfolio Operations Manager to build the tools, data solutions, and rhythms that keep our games portfolio clear to the teams who support it. You'll design scalable tools and workflows, use AI to cut manual work and improve reporting, and lead the change management that lets the business adapt quickly.

Netflix Games is building the next generation of games for a worldwide audience. The Games portfolio sits where many teams across Netflix meet: Content, Marketing, Legal, Technology, Discovery, and more. Portfolio Operations Management is the connective tissue that keeps those teams in sync with what's happening across the portfolio.

We don't direct how games are made. We support the layer around them. We run shared portfolio tooling, keep portfolio state visible through reporting and monitoring, set and share the frameworks and standards that cross team boundaries, and help Games Leadership and cross-functional partners turn their needs into working processes.

The ideal candidate lives at the crossroads of program management and data solutions: equally comfortable leading a cross-functional program and designing the data model that powers it. You can effectively translate game production and development for non-production audiences, giving partners in Legal, Marketing, Finance, and Business Development the context they need to act. You'll develop, support, and improve the relational systems our partners rely on as their source of truth, find where AI and automation can remove friction, and deliver solutions that keep teams effortlessly connected. You're comfortable with ambiguity, you build trusting partnerships, and you prefer lightweight, scalable processes over heavy governance.

Responsibilities

Lead, scope, and operationalize cross-functional programs and projects involving multiple stakeholders with limited oversight.

Build and maintain scalable tools and workflows in our relational Airtable database: develop data models, build automations, and design interfaces.

Run regular audits to consolidate or retire redundant fields, tables, views, and automations, keeping systems performant, secure, and easy to navigate.

Use AI tools and agents for operational efficiency, workflow optimization, and intuitive reporting. Find high-leverage opportunities, prototype quickly, and bring proven solutions into production.

Improve portfolio reporting and data monitoring so Games Leadership and partners have accurate, timely visibility to ground and support their decisions.

Translate game production and development concepts (lifecycle phases, gates, milestones, live operations) into clear, actionable context for Games Leadership and non-production partners.

Own data hygiene and accuracy across the tools you support. Monitor health, fix what's broken, and help users serve themselves.

Turn a partner's need into a working process. Know when a tool, automation, playbook, workflow, report, or ritual is the right answer.

Own change management for rollouts, updates, and deprecations: testing, communication, training, adoption, and support - each grounded in a clear what, who, and why with confirmed buy-in.

Bring prioritized, evidence-backed feature requests and user stories to internal tooling and platform product and engineering owners on behalf of the portfolio.

Scope incoming work with discipline. Prioritize work that supports multiple users and that is backed by clear business objectives.

Write durable runbooks, training, and documentation so systems and rhythms outlast any one person.

Requirements

8+ years in operations, program management, business systems, or a related field. Games experience preferred, but not required.

Hands-on experience designing and maintaining relational databases and the workflows built on them. Advanced Airtable experience (schema design, linked records, automations, scripting, interfaces) strongly preferred.

A track record of building scalable internal tools, automations, or reporting that other teams enthusiastically adopt and rely on.

Practical experience using AI tools (LLMs, agents, AI-assisted automation) to improve operations, workflows, or reporting, with good judgment about where AI adds value and where it doesn't.

Strong data skills: modeling, hygiene, and turning raw data into clear, decision-ready reporting. SQL, scripting (JavaScript or Python), or BI tool experience is a plus.

Knowledge of data governance principles, data quality standards, and metadata management.

Proven change management skills, landing rollouts across many stakeholders with measurable adoption.

Ability to translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements and user stories for product and engineering teams.

Clear, proactive communicator who builds lasting partnerships across leadership, production, development, and highly matrixed cross-functional teams.

Comfortable with ambiguity, with a people-over-process mindset and a bias toward lightweight, adoptable solutions.

 
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $170,000.00 - $250,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here. 

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:
$110,500.00 - $152,000.00

Location:
Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Your Key Responsibilities

Develop comprehensive project plans and lead projects from conception and planning through implementation and deployment.

Contribute to the development of project strategies, processes, and resource plans.

Manage project schedules and task execution using project management tools, including status reports, tracking charts, checklists, and scheduling software.

Drive cost, schedule, and performance objectives for equipment and deliverables supporting internal and external customers and global vendors.

Participate in and support cross-functional design teams composed of internal, external, and matrixed resources to achieve project goals.

Provide technical input and guidance to team members to support successful project execution.

Interface with internal stakeholders across engineering, operations, supply chain, and business teams to drive supply chain projects supporting the AGS business unit.

Identify project risks and issues and develop mitigation and resolution plans.

Qualifications Necessary for Success

Minimum of 5 years of experience in program management, project management, engineering, or supply chain management.

Bachelor’s degree required in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.

Some engineering/technical background with experience in the semiconductor industry and/or supply chain management is preferred

Strong program management experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a technical or manufacturing environment.

Preferred experience with semiconductor components including OEM components, process power systems, build-to-print parts, advanced materials, and mechanical or electrical assemblies.

Experience working with global suppliers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Strong communication, influence, and negotiation skills in a matrixed organization.

Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret large datasets, synthesizing insights and effectively presenting findings to senior executive leadership

Core Competencies

Functional Knowledge: Demonstrates depth or breadth of expertise in a specialized technical or functional discipline.

Business Expertise: Interprets business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes, or services.

Leadership: Leads teams or projects with moderate complexity, risk, and resource requirements.

Additional Information

Time Type:
Full time

Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular

Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:
No

In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

This contact is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

title: Senior TPM, Mathematical Software
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.


We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

US Salary Range
$144,000—$192,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
