title: Strategic Real Estate, Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary
Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead, you will own the planning process that decides how much space Anduril needs, of what type, where, and when.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. You'll turn headcount plans, program schedules, and portfolio data into forecasts of demand and supply. You'll measure how well we use what we already have, and make the case for what to do next to division leaders and the C-suite.

This is a hands-on senior role. It suits someone who builds their own models and can work from incomplete, inconsistent data. You should already use LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar) in your work. The ideal candidate combines real estate and financial judgment with a builder's instinct and a creative, tech-forward approach to problems that have no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Real Estate Planning Cycle. Run the quarterly portfolio forecast end to end:
    • Gather headcount and program plans from Finance, Corporate Operations, and the business divisions;
    • Reconcile competing plans into one view of demand by division, workforce type, and region;
    • Publish the 5–10 year outlook that portfolio decisions rest on;
    • Track plan vs. actual across forecast versions, and explain why the numbers moved.
  • Portfolio Demand & Supply Forecasting. Forecast seat, office, R&D, and production space demand against current and committed supply. Quantify the gaps by market and year. Model scenarios (growth cases, program wins and losses, M&A, relocations, divestitures) and their OpEx and CapEx impact.
  • Efficiency & Utilization Measurement. Define and track the metrics that show whether the portfolio is working: SF per head, seat ratios, utilization, cost per seat, and production space relative to output. Benchmark them against peers. Turn the findings into recommendations to consolidate, densify, restructure leases, or expand.
  • Workforce Strategy. Work with Talent, People, and division leaders to understand how Anduril grows: hiring velocity, workforce mix (engineering, production, G&A), in-office patterns, and talent markets. Translate that into location strategy, market selection, and site timing.
  • Executive Communications. Build and present the decision materials that get C-suite and division-leader decisions made: quarterly business reviews, expansion option analyses, and leadership briefings. Lead with the answer, show the math, and stand behind the numbers.
  • Build the Planning System, Not Just the Plan. Maintain and extend our planning data pipeline and models (Palantir Foundry, Python/SQL, version-controlled datasets with automated validation), so forecasts are repeatable, auditable, and refreshable in hours. Use LLM-based agents to automate data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, and presentation production, and set the standard for how the team uses them.


Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Data / Information Science, Urban Planning, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic real estate planning, corporate portfolio strategy, FP&A, capacity or workforce planning, real estate investing (equity or credit), development, or corporate development, including experience leading or mentoring analysts/associates.
  • Strong financial and analytical modeling. You build your own models in Excel and Python or SQL, and can defend every number in them.
  • Hands-on use of LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or dbt) in your current work.
  • Excellent communication, with a demonstrated capacity to influence cross-functional teams and senior executives.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% for site visits, stakeholder meetings, and industry events.
  • U.S. citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience forecasting space for manufacturing, R&D, or other capital-intensive operations, not only office.
  • A track record of building forecasts from incomplete or conflicting plan data, and explaining to leadership why they changed.
  • Experience planning around M&A integration, relocations, or consolidations.
  • Background in defense, aerospace, or another fast-growing hardware company.

Description

Prime Air is seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive airworthiness certification programs for the MK30 unmanned aircraft system. You will own the plans, schedules, and compliance tracking that turn certification strategy into execution. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and regulatory compliance. You will coordinate across software, hardware, systems, and test teams to keep certification deliverables on track and surface risks early.

A key dimension of this role is international regulatory coordination. Prime Air operates across multiple countries, each with its own aviation authority and certification expectations. You will manage the programs that drive international approvals of the drone system. You will track regulatory deltas across jurisdictions and maximize reuse of compliance evidence, so each country is not run as a separate program.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Engineering Certification.

Key job responsibilities

Own the plans, schedules, and compliance matrices for Prime Air's certification programs across DO-178C (software), DO-254 (hardware), and DO-160G (environmental qualification).

Track certification objectives against engineering deliverables. Identify gaps and dependencies early, and drive them to closure.

Partner with engineering teams to sequence certification work within the development lifecycle. Escalate schedule and resource risks to leadership.

Build and maintain the status reporting, metrics, and dashboards that give leadership visibility into certification progress

Coordinate the programs that support regulatory engagement across the markets Prime Air operates in (EASA, CASA, DGCA, CAA, JCAB, and others).

Track regulatory requirements and deltas across authorities. Manage the evidence reuse plan that supports bilateral validation processes (for example, FAA-to-EASA) to reduce international approval timelines.

Monitor emerging regulations (for example, EU U-Space, FAA BVLOS rulemaking) and fold new requirements into program plans before they become blockers.

Drive alignment across engineering, regulatory, and certification teams on scope, milestones, and means of compliance.

Support the Senior Manager and certification engineers in preparing compliance arguments and documentation for the FAA, EASA, and international DERs/CVEs.

Establish and improve the program mechanisms that scale certification delivery as Prime Air expands internationally.

About the team

This is a new organization within Prime Air to own the technical execution of certification to support our world-wide expansion focus in 2027 and beyond.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

The Amazon Leo Electronic Supply Chain team is seeking an Operations Technical Program Manager to drive technical manufacturing and supply chain operations for Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBA) destined for our satellites. The successful candidate will manage contract manufacturers' end-to-end production processes and work with internal customers like design and reliability engineering while maintaining a focus on quality and delivery requirements.

Key job responsibilities

• Manage contract manufacturers' end-to-end production process for assigned PCBAs

• Manage roadmaps and schedules for the PCBAs and various build

• Take on projects and programs to improve org-wide initiatives, e.g., cycle time and quality metrics

• Ensure on-time delivery to meet Amazon Leo production rate requirements

• Drive production planning and execution aligned with cross-functional priorities

• Measure, Control and Improve capacity, quality, manufacturing rate/processes, and delivery KPIs at contract manufacturers

• Lead technical deep dives to resolve manufacturing blockers and constraints

• Balance development and engineering needs to minimize production impacts

• Implement continuous improvement initiatives to optimize production efficiency

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate supply chain risks

• Develop and maintain supplier performance metrics and reporting systems

NOTE: This role requires the ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 25% of the time

A day in the life

As an Operations TPM at Amazon Leo, you'll start your day reviewing upcoming deliveries, blockers and constraints, and production metrics across your contract manufacturers. You'll participate in daily production meetings to address, update and escalate immediate issues, working with cross functional partners. Throughout the day, you'll analyze production performance data to identify bottlenecks, conduct deep-dive investigations into constraints, and work with suppliers to implement process improvements.

You will partner with engineering teams on technical reviews to evaluate new design requirements, impact analysis, manufacturing challenges, and schedule trade-offs. You'll regularly present performance updates to leadership, support Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews, and lead projects, collaborating with peers, that will improve org-wide initiatives. The role requires a balance of tactical execution and strategic thinking to ensure both daily delivery and long-term manufacturing capability needs are met.

At Amazon, we embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We operate with high standards and a strong sense of ownership, working backwards from our customers' needs to deliver innovative solutions in satellite manufacturing.

- 5+ years of program or project management experience, or a Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of supply chain experience

- 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience leading cross-functional projects and managing large, complicated programs

- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues

- Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and make data-driven decisions

- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration

- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma

- Technical understanding of PCBA manufacturing processes and materials, capacity assessments, and quality requirements

- Direct experience managing high-complexity electronics contract manufacturers, preferably in aerospace or defense industries

The Technical Production Program Manager 2 will lead and manage production of the Advanced Anti-Radiation Guided Missile (AARGM), an air-launched, counter-air-defense weapon system for U.S. and FMS customers.  The Production Program Manager oversees production contract execution phases including: kick-off, planning, material procurement, manufacturing, and delivery.

description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is hiring a Process Engineering Manager to oversee our Electrode Manufacturing Operations. In this role, you will lead a team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians responsible for the performance, reliability, and efficiency of our electrode production lines — spanning powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation processes. You'll bring strong technical judgment grounded in material science, along with a data-driven approach, to guide your team in diagnosing process issues, prioritizing improvement projects, and implementing robust, high-impact solutions on the floor. You will own staffing, coaching, and performance management for your team, while partnering with cross-functional engineering leaders to translate process and materials insights into meaningful, lasting manufacturing improvements. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your process engineering background, materials expertise, and leadership experience to build a world-class, fully automated electrode production process.

Relocation assistance is available. 

What you'll do:

Own the section's operating results across powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation, holding your team accountable for line cadence, downtime, and overall throughput

Manage and develop a small, mostly-engineer team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians, including staffing, coaching, and performance decisions

Establish and track section-level metrics (OEE, yield, cycle time) and direct resourcing toward the highest-impact bottlenecks across each process step

Set methods and standards for evaluating and vetting floor-level solutions, ensuring fixes across the powder-to-tape process are safe, robust, and grounded in sound material science before scale-up

Represent the section in cross-functional planning with peer engineering and manufacturing teams, resolving constraints that affect quality and throughput company-wide

Build and prioritize a continuous improvement roadmap for the section, balancing waste reduction, ergonomics, and process reliability against production demands

What you'll bring:

Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemical, Mechanical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or related field

7+ years in manufacturing/production operations, including team management experience

Strong material science foundation — able to connect powder properties and tape mechanics to process outcomes

Proven track record hiring, developing, and managing process/equipment engineers or technicians

Deep familiarity with manufacturing metrics (OEE, downtime) and a root-cause approach to problem-solving

Working knowledge of roll-to-roll processes — powder transformation, mixing, web handling

Strong influencing skills and experience representing your team's priorities to peer managers and engineering leadership

Pragmatic, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity as the organization scales

Where you'll work:

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

The DSTPA team is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will own end-to-end incident response and crisis management for high-severity, trust-impacting events — from detection and intake through containment, mitigation, and closure — and run the mechanisms, playbooks, and governance that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident commander during active events, drive escalations with urgency, and keep senior leadership informed with crisp, decision-ready briefs. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and anchors our continuous, cross-time-zone (follow-the-sun) coverage from the India site.

A successful candidate will have an established background leading complex, cross-functional programs under pressure, excellent program-management, problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with stakeholders at all levels. The candidate should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, possess the business judgment to make high-stakes calls in ambiguous situations, write compelling executive briefs, and drive outcomes for senior leadership. The ability to influence cross-functionally — and to hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure — will be absolutely critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities

- Act as incident commander for high-severity, trust-impacting events; own incident-command protocols, incident rooms, severity matrices, escalation pathways, and decision frameworks

- Own escalation management end to end — escalate at the right time, pull in the right owners and decision-makers, and drive issues to resolution without letting them stall

- Design, implement, and own crisis response playbooks, mechanisms, and tabletop exercises to ensure organizational readiness

- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), and track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure

- Write compelling senior-leadership and executive briefs (narratives, escalation briefs, status reports) that synthesize complex, cross-domain trust issues into clear decisions, risks, and asks

- Define, monitor, and improve operational metrics — mean time to triage, mean time to contain, mean time to resolve, and post-incident SLA compliance

Between events you invest in readiness: running tabletop drills, tightening playbooks, driving corrective actions to closure, and partnering with Engineering to embed Trust by Design upstream so recurring patterns stop repeating.

About the team

TRIM is a horizontal organization within DSTPA responsible for building the technologies, programs, and services at Amazon scale that instill and grow customer trust, create mechanisms to attain ever-evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can meet their trust obligations without disruption. Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function runs a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events — detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence, and we support new members across a broad mix of experience levels and tenures in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 3+ years of software development experience

- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

description:

Westcoast

Meet the Team

You will join an elite, mission-driven sales organization within Cisco’s U.S. Federal Defense operation dedicated to empowering the United States Air Force and Space Force. As a Senior Account Executive supporting the US Air Force, you will play a critical role in enabling the mission readiness, secure digital modernization, and warfighter capabilities of our defense customer.

Serving as the Account Orchestrator, you will build and manage multi-year strategic relationships across designated Air Force commands and regional installations (such as Peterson SFB, Schriever SFB, Buckley SFB, Cheyenne Mountain, and the U.S. Air Force Academy). You will partner closely with Portfolio Solutions Engineers, Architecture Specialists, and executive defense leadership to drive sustainable, cross-portfolio growth and align Cisco's industry-leading technology with customer mission imperatives.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Account Orchestration & Deal Leadership: Orchestrate multi-faceted, highly complex deal cycles ($100K to $30M+) involving multiple stakeholders, defense commands, and program offices to drive impactful revenue growth and mission transformation.

Air Force Executive & Flag-Level Engagement: Engage with senior military and civilian leaders across the Air Force and Space Force, serving as the primary trusted advisor and commercial influencer in purchasing decisions.

Cross-Portfolio & Secure Networking Positioning: Drive sustainable cross-portfolio growth with deep expertise in core secure networking (enterprise switching, routing, wireless, and next-generation firewall), while collaborating with specialist teams on advanced security, cloud, and observability architectures.

Opportunity Qualification, Funnel Velocity & Forecasting: Build a robust sales pipeline through proactive opportunity prospecting; manage opportunities through all deal stages; maintain accurate representation in Cisco CRM; and analyze data to deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales commitments.

Consultative Deal Structuring & Negotiations: Lead commercial and contract negotiations with a consultative approach, expertly balancing competitive pricing, service level agreements, and multi-year federal contractual commitments (SEWP, GSA, DoD Enterprise Agreements).

Cross-Functional Teaming & Partner Teaming: Direct and align extended team resources (Portfolio SEs, TSAs, Services, RevOps, Legal, and Finance) and coordinate with defense ecosystem partners to deliver unified customer outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ to 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise technology sales, strategic business development, or defense IT account management experience.

Demonstrated track record of successfully managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles ($1M+ to $10M+) and achieving annual sales quotas.

Solid foundational knowledge of enterprise networking and cybersecurity architectures, with specific focus on core secure networking (switching, routing, wireless, and firewall).

Proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional sales engineering, product specialist, legal, and commercial teams to navigate complex federal procurement cycles.

U.S. Citizenship required to comply with federal customer site access, background investigation, and security clearance requirements.

Ability to work in a hybrid, field-based model located in or near Denver, Colorado with travel to regional military installations and partner sites.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (with 5+ years of experience), Master’s degree (with 3+ years of experience), or equivalent practical experience in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Extensive experience selling enterprise software, hardware, or cloud solutions directly to the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), specifically the U.S. Air Force or U.S. Space Force.

Active U.S. Government Security Clearance (Secret or Top Secret / SCI).

Prior military service or experience working within defense acquisition commands (AFMC, AFLCMC, SSC, ACC, AMC, NORAD/USNORTHCOM).

Familiarity with DoD procurement contract vehicles, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFARS), and multi-year enterprise software agreements (DoD ESI, 2GIT, NASA SEWP).

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Sr Portfolio Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Portfolio Manager based in the United States.

The Senior Portfolio Manager will provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across a portfolio of federal government programs, ensuring successful delivery, financial performance, and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will manage complex projects, oversee multidisciplinary teams, and build strong relationships with senior government stakeholders. You will be responsible for balancing program execution, personnel management, contractual compliance, and business growth initiatives. Working closely with delivery, finance, recruiting, and business development teams, you will identify opportunities to expand existing accounts while maintaining operational excellence. You will also drive workforce development, resource planning, and performance management to ensure teams are equipped to meet evolving customer needs. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced leader with a strong background in federal programs, consulting, and cybersecurity to make a significant impact in a dynamic, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities:

Program and Delivery Management

Provide executive oversight of programs, projects, and task orders within the assigned customer portfolio.

Ensure all engagements are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual obligations and customer expectations.

Develop and monitor project plans, milestones, staffing requirements, dependencies, risks, and corrective actions.

Ensure contractual deliverables meet quality standards and are submitted accurately and on time.

Identify and escalate delivery, staffing, financial, and customer-related risks, driving issues through resolution.

Maintain strong customer relationships and serve as the primary escalation point for program delivery matters.

Capture program achievements, performance metrics, and success stories to support business development activities.

Personnel Management and Supervision

Provide first-line supervision, daily guidance, coaching, and performance management for assigned employees.

Establish clear performance expectations and align individual objectives with project, account, customer, and organizational goals.

Conduct regular one-on-one meetings to discuss performance, workload, professional development, engagement, and employee concerns.

Complete performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback, recognition, and development recommendations.

Identify opportunities for employee growth through training, certifications, professional development, and career advancement.

Address performance and conduct issues in coordination with Human Resources and delivery leadership.

Review and approve timecards, leave requests, and other personnel actions in accordance with company policies and contractual requirements.

Monitor employee utilization, workload, availability, and assignments to ensure effective resource deployment.

Support employee retention by proactively addressing engagement, career development, workload, and assignment concerns.

Participate in recruitment, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, promotions, resource assignments, and offboarding activities.

Maintain regular communication with remote employees and personnel working at customer locations to promote engagement and organizational alignment.

Coordinate staffing transitions and succession planning to maintain continuity of service delivery.

Account Growth and Business Development

Develop and execute strategic account growth plans for assigned customer groups.

Identify opportunities to expand existing programs through additional scopes of work, task orders, contract vehicles, and adjacent customer requirements.

Establish and monitor account-level targets for revenue, backlog, funded work, and workforce growth.

Collaborate with business development and capture teams to identify, qualify, shape, and pursue new business opportunities.

Maintain awareness of customer priorities, budgets, acquisition strategies, upcoming procurements, and competitive activity.

Translate anticipated growth opportunities into staffing and recruitment forecasts to ensure appropriate resources are available.

Customer Relationship Management

Serve as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for key customer stakeholders.

Build and maintain relationships with government program leaders, contracting representatives, technical leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.

Conduct regular customer meetings and account reviews to assess performance, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.

Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address concerns or service delivery issues.

Ensure delivery teams understand changing customer mission requirements and strategic priorities.

Balance customer expectations with responsibility for employee performance, professional development, and well-being.

Contract Compliance and Administration

Maintain oversight of contractual requirements, including scope, funding, performance periods, labor categories, staffing, deliverables, and reporting obligations.

Partner with Contracts and Finance teams to ensure compliance with contract terms and applicable government and organizational requirements.

Monitor contract funding, burn rates, ceilings, option periods, and key milestones.

Coordinate with Finance to ensure contract and project information within Unanet is accurate and regularly updated.

Ensure employees are assigned to authorized labor categories, work locations, and contractual responsibilities.

Promote compliance with customer requirements, security policies, timekeeping procedures, and internal standards.

Financial and Operational Management

Maintain accountability for the financial performance of the assigned account and its underlying programs.

Monitor revenue, labor utilization, project costs, profit margins, forecasts, and other financial performance indicators.

Maintain approximately 50% individual billable utilization through direct customer engagement or program delivery, balancing these responsibilities with portfolio leadership, personnel supervision, and business development.

Ensure accurate and timely employee and subcontractor timekeeping, with appropriate project and contract charge codes.

Review and approve personnel time records in accordance with established procedures.

Support accurate and timely customer invoicing and resolve billing discrepancies.

Work with Finance to maintain reliable revenue, resource, and staffing forecasts.

Identify financial and operational variances and implement appropriate corrective actions.

Performance Metrics and Reporting

Establish and maintain account-level performance scorecards.

Track key indicators, including revenue, margins, staffing, headcount, utilization, vacancies, deliverable status, customer satisfaction, invoice status, contract funding, burn rates, and growth pipeline.

Provide regular performance reports and financial forecasts to the Federal Services Director.

Maintain visibility into program risks, issues, opportunities, and corrective actions.

Deliver accurate and timely reporting to support leadership decisions and resource allocation.

Team and Organizational Leadership

Provide leadership and direction to Program Managers, Project Managers, technical leads, and other delivery professionals.

Build cohesive account teams with clear responsibilities across delivery, personnel management, customer engagement, and business development.

Maintain appropriate staffing levels and proactively address recruitment, retention, performance, and succession planning needs.

Partner with Recruiting and Human Resources to forecast workforce requirements and fill critical positions.

Promote accountability, communication, collaboration, and consistent delivery practices.

Mentor high-performing employees, delegate responsibilities, and develop future organizational leaders.

Foster a culture of customer service, professional development, operational excellence, and accountability.

Key Deliverables

Develop engagement delivery plans, staffing strategies, and project status reports.

Produce utilization and capacity forecasts aligned with active engagements and business development opportunities.

Prepare engagement financial reports covering budgets, gross margins, and profitability.

Develop Statements of Work (SOWs), change orders, and contract compliance documentation.

Create team development plans, performance reviews, and certification or upskilling roadmaps.

Contribute to delivery methodologies, templates, service catalogs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Produce thought leadership materials, including white papers, blog posts, and technical accelerators, and represent the organization at relevant industry events.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related discipline.

7–10+ years of relevant professional experience, including at least 3 years managing consulting or professional services teams and/or overseeing federal programs.

Demonstrated ability to balance direct, billable customer delivery responsibilities with portfolio leadership, personnel management, financial oversight, and business development.

In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity and information security domains, including cloud security, endpoint protection, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

Familiarity with established security frameworks and standards, such as NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.

Experience with project management methodologies, tools, and program delivery practices.

Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP are strongly preferred.

Strong leadership and people management capabilities, with experience coaching, mentoring, and developing multidisciplinary teams.

Excellent communication, organizational, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong financial and operational management abilities, including budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and performance monitoring.

Proven ability to manage multiple complex engagements while maintaining quality, contractual compliance, and customer satisfaction.

Ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance is required.

Experience building or scaling professional services or engineering teams is preferred.

Previous experience in fast-paced consulting environments is highly desirable.

High levels of integrity, accountability, adaptability, and strategic thinking.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation: Attractive salary package, paid twice monthly.

Annual performance bonus: Additional compensation tied to business segment results.

Healthcare coverage: Comprehensive medical insurance, with 100% of medical premiums covered by the employer.

Retirement savings: 401(k) plan with a 100% company match on the first 4% of eligible contributions.

Paid time off: Three weeks of PTO starting from the first year of employment.

Paid holidays: 11 paid holidays annually.

Family support: Paid maternity and paternity leave.

Remote work support: Monthly reimbursement for cell phone and home internet expenses.

Business development incentives: Companywide incentive programs rewarding contributions to new business opportunities.

Thought leadership incentives: Recognition and incentives for producing white papers, blog posts, internal webinars, and other knowledge-sharing contributions.

Professional growth: Opportunities to contribute to technical initiatives, develop expertise, and support organizational innovation.

Flexible work environment: Remote working arrangement within the United States.

Description

Are you interested in a challenge that will reward your unique blend of business and technology skills? Are you excited by the opportunity to be central in addressing significant business-impacting processes and products? Do you enjoy the challenge and ownership that comes from delivering large, cross-functional, IT projects? As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) for IT Services, you will have the opportunity to play a pivotal role in the future of IT Services. As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, you will be the glue between stakeholders to ensure our customers receive the right outcomes that drive customer obsessed security. As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager for the IT Services organization, you will facilitate the transition of critical IT Services used by our customers to an externalized network platform that has no reliance on a traditional private corporate style network. In this role you will be the primary point of contact for the assigned services to align customer technical requirements to the business strategy by working cross functionally. This role requires senior program and project management experience, as customer engagement, stakeholder management and effective communication is critical. This role requires you to have effective written and verbal skills as this program has director and VP level visibility. As a TIPM you will ensure projects in the program are being scoped, planned, delivered and closed in line with the agreed success measures, budget, schedule and quality. This will require you to partner with service owners and operators to determine the right business outcomes. 

Roles and Responsibilities 

- Manage and own complex projects having enterprise wide impact.

- Establish the forward looking strategy and gain support for implementation.

- Conduct pre-project requirement gathering, scoping, project approval, planning, oversee delivery and verification of strategic goals.

- Develop gap analysis, functional specifications, project schedules and milestones.

- Work with stakeholders to identify resources, assemble project teams, and assign responsibilities.

- Assess costs, benefits and risks, plus identify and respond to risks and high-priority issues rapidly and effectively through effective action and appropriate escalation.

- Balance business needs with technical and security requirements.

- Clearly communicate goals, responsibilities, issues and status to customers and senior managers.

- Lead and streamline the transition of IT Services in to production.

- Ensure changes are effectively released ensuring feedback mechanisms are established.

- Build effective relationships with stakeholder and service owners.

- Publish accurate and concise reports on time to maintain visibility and accountability.

Success in this role will require: 

- Excellent project and program management skills.

- Thrive in the face of ambiguity and not be deterred to address and prioritize multiple projects.

- Understand strategic initiatives and drive them to a successful conclusion.

- Build trusting relationships allowing you to own and drive programs.

- Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical, written and presentation skills.

- Experience with detailed project planning, reporting, risk management and measurement.

- Strong multi-tasking and influencing skills.

- Excellent organization, analytical, quantitative, and presentation skills.

- Strong bias for action and "get it done" attitude.

- Flexibility to travel, both domestically and internationally, and work within global time zones.

Key job responsibilities

The key job functions of the Technical Infrastructure Program Manager are:

- Own the identification, scoping, and delivery strategy for the Infrastructure and AV solutions in Amazon offices.

- Own projects and initiatives having regional impact, including project schedules and milestones.

- Effectively manage stakeholders to successfully deliver the agreed scope.

- Understand and identify technical obstacles to successfully deliver the designed architecture, identify and mitigate risks.

- Assess costs and benefits and maintain financial reporting control.

- Manage escalation, anticipate and make tradeoffs and balance business needs with technical constraints.

description:
Job Description

The core responsibility of this role is a hands-on project delivery partner and PMO lead for emerging technology, AI, and automation in support of major change initiatives/projects in GCTO. The role will also help coordinate PMO tracking and reporting, and work to ensure technology best practices are being applied across initiatives. They will apply data stewardship and data governance principles in the management of applications. The incumbent may also identify, evaluate, build, pilot, and scale digital, AI, and automation solutions that support GCTO.  

Primary responsibilities for the role include: 

Key Responsibilities: 

PMO project coordination 

Contribute to the ongoing management of strategic process improvement initiatives within GCTO. 

Provide general and project support to project managers by promoting cross-initiative alignment and best practice sharing.

AI/Automation strategy & intake 

Partner across HQ Ops and GCTO functions to surface priority pain points and high-value opportunities for automation, analytics, and AI. 

Lead development of business cases including problem definition, options analysis, solution scope, resource/cost estimates, benefits/KPIs, risks, and compliance considerations.

Align local opportunities with GCTO priorities; verify with relevant GCDI/central repositories and teams if there are for similar tools to avoid duplication; summarize reuse opportunities and recommendations as appropriate.

Solution design & delivery

Lead and drive the end-to-end delivery of tools and solutions (e.g., dashboards, workflow automation, AI-assisted processes) using appropriate platforms and methods.

Responsible for escalation to centralized assessment when project requirements exceed local capability or scale.

Translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and oversee build, testing, validation, and controlled deployment; ensure security, privacy, and quality.

Project reporting, tracking & analytics

Develop or oversee development of project analytics and visualization (e.g., GCTO Project Catalog, GCTO Change Management Dashboard, GCTO Pilot Tracker, etc) to track deadlines, deliverables, resources and timelines.

Define and track project success metrics (e.g., cycle-time reduction, accuracy, adoption/satisfaction, cost avoidance/FTE savings) and embed learning loops for continuous improvement.

Governance, compliance & change

Ensure solutions comply with ICH GCP, Company policies, and local regulations; partner with Compliance/Legal as needed.

Maintain project tracking and provide periodic updates via relevant governance forums; support RRO governance processes.

Lead change management efforts, including training plans, communications, and stakeholder engagement; contribute to capability uplift in data literacy and digital ways of working.

Collaboration & solution scaling

Serve as a PMO liaison with functional representatives, Automation/Analytics/AI partners, and when required, IT and external vendors for integration and support.

Share learnings and reusable assets with other functions and project teams; assess and adapt project-specific tools for local use.

Educational Requirements: 

Bachelor’s degree in a life science discipline, business analytics, computing science, engineering, or related field. 

 

Required Experience: 

Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in data/analytics, process improvement, or technology-enabled transformation within life sciences/healthcare or a comparable regulated environment which includes: 

Successfully designing and delivering automation/analytics/AI-enabled solutions (e.g., dashboards, RPA/workflow automation, AI/ML pilots) that produced measurable improvements. 

Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, with hands-on project management in a matrix environment. 

 

Preferred Experience: 

Experience working across multiple functions or on cross-functional process improvement initiatives. 

Exposure to integrations with IT/data science teams. 

Familiarity with clinical trial processes and operational metrics. 

Compliance/regulatory: understanding of ICH GCP and applicable quality and data protection requirements. 

 

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

Business process modeling and requirements techniques: e.g., process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications 

End-to-end product and solution ownership mindset: with accountability for value delivery across the full solution lifecycle (ideation, MVP, rollout, scaling, maintenance, and retirement). 

Data literacy and analytics: ability to translate business questions into metrics; hands-on with BI tools (e.g., Power BI/Tableau) and data querying basics (SQL or equivalent). 

Automation/AI awareness: practical experience with workflow automation/RPA platforms; exposure to AI/ML use cases and constraints in clinical operations. 

Program/project management: planning, prioritization, risk/issue management, and delivery at pace; comfortable with Agile/Lean practices. 

Communication & influence; ability to influence across functions and present technical topics to non-technical audiences. 

Change enablement: stakeholder engagement, training, and adoption support. 

Problem-solving & critical thinking: structured analysis, hypothesis-driven approach, and pragmatic delivery mindset. 

Required Skills: 
Adaptability, Automation, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analytics, Process Improvements, Project Management, Risk Management, Solutions Delivery, Stakeholder Communications, Workflow Automation

title: Global PMO Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Global PMO Lead based in United States .

The Global PMO Lead will establish and lead a global Program Management Office, ensuring that the organisation’s most important cross-functional initiatives are delivered effectively across regions and business units. This hands-on leadership role combines direct ownership of complex strategic programs with the development of a scalable, practical PMO operating model. You will work closely with senior executives and functional leaders to translate business priorities into clear execution plans, improve visibility, and address risks before they affect delivery. You will also build and develop a team of program managers who act as trusted execution partners rather than administrative coordinators. In a fast-growing, international environment, you will bring structure to ambiguity while keeping processes lightweight and adaptable. Your work will directly strengthen accountability, resource allocation, and the organisation’s ability to deliver its highest-impact priorities.

Accountabilities

Lead high-priority, cross-functional programs from ambiguous initial requirements through planning, coordination, and successful delivery.

Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans with clear sponsors, owners, milestones, dependencies, timelines, and success criteria.

Partner with senior leadership to identify and prioritise a focused portfolio of high-impact initiatives.

Provide executive teams with a consolidated, accurate overview of program progress, milestones, risks, resource constraints, and decisions required.

Identify and address blockers, unclear ownership, handoff issues, and cross-functional dependencies, escalating risks when necessary.

Establish a lightweight, globally consistent PMO operating model covering prioritisation, planning, execution, reporting, and escalation.

Adapt processes to different regional and functional needs while building on existing weekly, monthly, and quarterly operating rhythms.

Coordinate competing priorities and resource constraints across the program portfolio, helping leaders make informed trade-offs.

Recruit, manage, and develop a team of program managers, ensuring every major initiative has clear execution ownership.

Build a service-oriented PMO that supports functional and regional leaders without becoming an additional approval layer or decision-making bottleneck.

Improve delivery predictability while reducing duplicated work and unnecessary coordination overhead.

Requirements:

Proven experience personally leading multiple high-priority, cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous requirements through successful delivery.

Experience building, scaling, or significantly improving a PMO or enterprise program management function.

Background managing programs across multiple countries, business units, or distributed organisations.

Demonstrated ability to work directly with C-level executives and functional leaders to establish priorities, resolve conflicts, and drive execution without relying on direct authority.

Experience managing competing initiatives, portfolio-level priorities, and limited resources.

Previous experience managing, coaching, and developing program managers or comparable cross-functional execution teams.

Strong capabilities in program tracking, executive reporting, accountability frameworks, and delivery performance improvement.

Ability to operate effectively in fast-growing organisations with evolving structures, shifting priorities, and significant ambiguity.

Comfortable moving between strategic portfolio oversight and hands-on program execution.

Nice to have: Experience in hardware, manufacturing, defence, government technology, or other complex delivery environments.

Nice to have: A professional services background or experience working in large, complex enterprises with substantial cross-functional dependencies.

Benefits:

Fully remote working arrangement.

Full-time employment.

Opportunity to build and lead a global PMO function with direct exposure to senior executives and strategic initiatives.

International working environment spanning multiple regions and business units.

title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping solve increasingly complex technical issues

  • Provide advice to customers and partners during engagements

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Strategy & Prioritization

title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

As a Senior G&E Executive, you are responsible for the organization and coordination of groups and events for Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon. From the first inquiry until the final evaluation, you make sure every detail is taken care of.

You manage a broad range of meetings, conferences, dinners, group bookings, and special events. With your experience and commercial mindset, you know how to translate clients' wishes into successful events while identifying opportunities to maximize revenue. You work closely with operational departments and are a trusted point of contact for both clients and colleagues.

As a senior member of the team, you take ownership of more complex requests and events, support your colleagues when needed, and contribute to continuously improving our commercial approach and way of working.

A FEW RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Managing groups, meetings, and events from the initial inquiry through to execution and follow-up.

  • Maximizing revenue and guest satisfaction by responding quickly to requests, converting inquiries into confirmed business, and identifying upselling opportunities.

  • Using your commercial insight to strategically manage pricing, availability, and event planning in line with the hotels' revenue objectives.

  • Taking ownership of larger and more complex groups and events and ensuring all agreements and details are communicated accurately.

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with corporate clients, agencies, event planners, and other business partners.

  • Ensuring contracts, deposits, cancellations, and invoicing are handled accurately and according to agreed procedures.

Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade is located in the heart of international The Hague, right next to the green Van Stolkpark. The hotel lies between The Hague city center and Scheveningen beach. Guests can relax in our Promenade Healthclub & Spa or enjoy delicious international dishes at LEO’S International Flavors.

Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade has 178 rooms and features a classic yet modern design, reflected throughout the hotel’s atmosphere. The hotel also offers 10 meeting rooms, making it the perfect choice for both business and leisure guests.

Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon has been an icon at The Hague Central Station since 1978 and is part of Leonardo Hotels. Centrally located, with a fantastic view and all the famous attractions within easy reach, the hotel has 143 rooms and several special meeting rooms. On the first floor of the hotel you will find our bar and restaurant "The Livingroom", where we create a real feeling of home for our guests.

At Leonardo Hotels, we care deeply about personal growth, connection, and making an impact together. On average, our colleagues work with us for four years because we always look for good internal career opportunities, and we are quite proud of that!

  • At least 2 to 3 years of relevant experience within Groups & Events, Meeting & Events, or a similar hospitality environment.

  • Strong command of the Dutch and English languages, both spoken and written.

  • You are organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.

  • Professional, service-oriented, and a true team player who enjoys sharing knowledge with colleagues.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, enabling you to connect easily with clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Strong numerical insight and the ability to think strategically while keeping an eye on the details.

  • You remain calm and solution-oriented when plans change, because in events, they sometimes do!

To be considered for this role, applicants must be an EU citizen or hold a valid work permit for the Netherlands.

• Clear internal growth opportunities.

• Access to a mental well-being support platform.

• Tax-friendly purchase options through a benefit program.

COME SOON TO DRINK COFFEE WITH US!

title: Payments Optimization Consultant
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You'll identify high-impact opportunities to improve payment performance by analysing merchant data, transaction trends, and industry benchmarks.

  • Identify opportunities to improve payment performance through merchant data, transaction trends, and industry benchmarks.

  • Build and refine payment optimisation methodologies and playbooks that help Airwallex stay ahead of industry developments.

  • Lead deep-dive conversations with enterprise merchants about payment performance, acting as a trusted strategic advisor to improve transaction outcomes.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to develop optimisation levers, including AI- and machine-learning-powered approaches to smart routing, cost reduction, and payment success.

  • Translate merchant feedback and frontline insights into product roadmap recommendations.

  • Enable Sales and Account Management teams with practical payment optimisation knowledge, tools, and training.

  • Build relationships with external stakeholders, including card issuers and payment networks, to improve the end-to-end payment experience.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years of experience in payments, with strong knowledge of e-commerce, card-based processing, and payment optimisation.

  • Strong understanding of card network rules, local payment methods, and regulatory requirements such as PSD2 and PSD3.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data and business intelligence tools to identify opportunities and explain performance trends.

  • Experience turning complex analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and commercial audiences.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Account Management teams.

  • A self-directed approach and the ability to make progress in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Intellectual curiosity and a practical approach to solving complex customer and payment problems.

Preferred

  • Experience with BI and data platforms such as Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or Databricks.

  • Experience working with payment optimisation, smart routing, fraud mitigation, or transaction success-rate improvement.

  • Experience engaging directly with card issuers, payment networks, or other global payments stakeholders.

  • Experience creating standardised methodologies, playbooks, or enablement programmes for commercial teams.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

Learn more about your team

Merchant Services at Airwallex is made up of two teams: Solutions Engineering and Technical Support, working together to turn customer-facing technical work into product progress. Across both teams, we help businesses design, integrate, launch, optimize, and scale on Airwallex's global financial infrastructure, covering solution architecture, delivery, technical account management, optimisation, and support.

The mandate is simple: solve for the customer in front of us, and build for the customers we haven't met yet. Sitting close to Product, Engineering, and Design means the patterns you see in real customer integrations can become better APIs, documentation, tooling, onboarding paths, and product capabilities. The hard part is doing both at once: shipping for today's customer without losing the signal that improves the product for the next.

This is a team for people who can earn trust with builders, reason through complex systems, communicate clearly, and stay grounded in commercial outcomes. If you want to work at the intersection of agentic finance, customer impact, and product development, this is where your work compounds.
